segments.sn42.11:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā mallesu viharati uruvelakappaṃ nāma mallānaṃ nigamo.
segments.sn42.11:1.2: Atha kho bhadrako gāmaṇi yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho bhadrako gāmaṇi bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn42.11:1.3: “sādhu me, bhante, bhagavā dukkhassa samudayañca atthaṅgamañca desetū”ti.
segments.sn42.11:1.4: “Ahañce [ahañca (syā. kaṃ. ka.)] te, gāmaṇi, atītamaddhānaṃ ārabbha dukkhassa samudayañca atthaṅgamañca deseyyaṃ –
segments.sn42.11:1.5: ‘evaṃ ahosi atītamaddhānan’ti, tatra te siyā kaṅkhā, siyā vimati.
segments.sn42.11:1.6: Ahaṃ ce [ahañca (syā. kaṃ. ka.)] te, gāmaṇi, anāgatamaddhānaṃ ārabbha dukkhassa samudayañca atthaṅgamañca deseyyaṃ –
segments.sn42.11:1.7: ‘evaṃ bhavissati anāgatamaddhānan’ti, tatrāpi te siyā kaṅkhā, siyā vimati.
segments.sn42.11:1.8: Api cāhaṃ, gāmaṇi, idheva nisinno ettheva te nisinnassa dukkhassa samudayañca atthaṅgamañca desessāmi.
segments.sn42.11:1.9: Taṃ suṇāhi, sādhukaṃ manasi karohi; bhāsissāmī”ti.
segments.sn42.11:1.10: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho bhadrako gāmaṇi bhagavato paccassosi.
segments.sn42.11:2.1: “Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gāmaṇi, atthi te uruvelakappe manussā yesaṃ te vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā uppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā”ti?
segments.sn42.11:2.3: “Atthi me, bhante, uruvelakappe manussā yesaṃ me vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā uppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā”ti.
segments.sn42.11:2.4: “Atthi pana te, gāmaṇi, uruvelakappe manussā yesaṃ te vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā nuppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā”ti?
segments.sn42.11:2.5: “Atthi me, bhante, uruvelakappe manussā yesaṃ me vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā nuppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā”ti.
segments.sn42.11:2.6: “Ko nu kho, gāmaṇi, hetu, ko paccayo yena te ekaccānaṃ uruvelakappiyānaṃ manussānaṃ vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā uppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā”ti?
segments.sn42.11:2.7: “Yesaṃ me, bhante, uruvelakappiyānaṃ manussānaṃ vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā uppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā, atthi me tesu chandarāgo.
segments.sn42.11:2.8: Yesaṃ pana, bhante, uruvelakappiyānaṃ manussānaṃ vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā nuppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā, natthi me tesu chandarāgo”ti.
segments.sn42.11:2.9: “Iminā tvaṃ, gāmaṇi, dhammena diṭṭhena viditena akālikena pattena pariyogāḷhena atītānāgate nayaṃ nehi –
segments.sn42.11:2.10: ‘yaṃ kho kiñci atītamaddhānaṃ dukkhaṃ uppajjamānaṃ uppajji [uppajjati (sabbattha)] sabbaṃ taṃ chandamūlakaṃ chandanidānaṃ.
segments.sn42.11:2.12: Yampi hi kiñci anāgatamaddhānaṃ dukkhaṃ uppajjamānaṃ uppajjissati, sabbaṃ taṃ chandamūlakaṃ chandanidānaṃ.
segments.sn42.11:2.15: Yāva subhāsitaṃ cidaṃ [subhāsitamidaṃ (sī. pī.)], bhante, bhagavatā [yaṅkiñci atītamaddhānaṃ dukkhaṃ uppajjamānaṃ uppajjati, sabbantaṃ chandamūlakaṃ chandanidānaṃ, chando hi mūlaṃ dukkhassāti, yaṅkiñci anāgatamaddhānaṃ dukkhaṃ uppajjamānaṃ uppajjissati sabbantaṃ chandamūlakaṃ chandanidānaṃ, chando hi mūlaṃ dukkhassā”ti (syā. kaṃ.)]–
segments.sn42.11:2.16: ‘yaṃ kiñci dukkhaṃ uppajjamānaṃ uppajjati, sabbaṃ taṃ chandamūlakaṃ chandanidānaṃ.
segments.sn42.11:2.17: Chando hi mūlaṃ dukkhassā’ti.[“yaṅkiñci atītamaddhānaṃ dukkhaṃ uppajjamānaṃ uppajjati, sabbantaṃ chandamūlakaṃ chandanidānaṃ, chando hi mūlaṃ dūkkhassāti, yaṅkiñci anāgatamaddhānaṃ dukkhaṃ uppajjamānaṃ uppajjissati, sabbantaṃ chandamūlakaṃ chandanidānaṃ, chando hi mūlaṃ dukkhassā”ti (syā. kaṃ)] Atthi me, bhante, ciravāsī nāma kumāro bahi āvasathe [āvesane (?)] paṭivasati.
segments.sn42.11:2.19: So khvāhaṃ, bhante, kālasseva vuṭṭhāya purisaṃ uyyojemi [uyyojesiṃ (ka.)]–
segments.sn42.11:2.21: Yāvakīvañca, bhante, so puriso nāgacchati, tassa me hoteva aññathattaṃ –
segments.sn42.11:2.22: ‘mā heva ciravāsissa kumārassa kiñci ābādhayitthā’”ti [ābādhayethāti (syā. kaṃ. pī. ka.)].
segments.sn42.11:3.1: “Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gāmaṇi, ciravāsissa kumārassa vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā uppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā”ti?
segments.sn42.11:3.3: “Ciravāsissa me, bhante, kumārassa vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā jīvitassapi siyā aññathattaṃ, kiṃ pana me nuppajjissanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā”ti.
segments.sn42.11:3.5: ‘yaṃ kiñci dukkhaṃ uppajjamānaṃ uppajjati, sabbaṃ taṃ chandamūlakaṃ chandanidānaṃ.
segments.sn42.11:4.1: “Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gāmaṇi, yadā te ciravāsimātā [ciravāsissa mātā (sī. pī.)] adiṭṭhā ahosi, assutā ahosi, te ciravāsimātuyā chando vā rāgo vā pemaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn42.11:4.4: “Dassanaṃ vā te, gāmaṇi, āgamma savanaṃ vā evaṃ te ahosi –
segments.sn42.11:4.5: ‘ciravāsimātuyā chando vā rāgo vā pemaṃ vā’”ti?
segments.sn42.11:5.1: “Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gāmaṇi, ciravāsimātuyā te vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā uppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā”ti?
segments.sn42.11:5.3: “Ciravāsimātuyā me, bhante, vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā jīvitassapi siyā aññathattaṃ, kiṃ pana me nuppajjissanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā”ti!
segments.sn42.11:5.5: ‘yaṃ kiñci dukkhaṃ uppajjamānaṃ uppajjati, sabbaṃ taṃ chandamūlakaṃ chandanidānaṃ.

lines: Akālikena pattenāti na kālantarena pattena, kālaṃ anatikkamitvāva pattenāti attho.
Bahi āvasathe paṭivasatīti bahinagare kiñcideva sippaṃ uggaṇhanto vasati.
Evaṃnāmaketi mallā nāma jānapadino rājakumārā, nesaṃ nivāsatāya “mallā” icceva bahuvacanavasena laddhanāmattā evaṃnāmake janapade.
Natthi etassa pattiyā kālantarasaññito kāloti akālo, so eva akāliko.

So pana “yaṃkiñci dukkhaṃ uppajjamānaṃ uppajjati, sabbaṃ taṃ chandamūlakan”ti evaṃ vutto dukkhassa chandamūlabhāvo, evaṃ chandamūlakassa dukkhassa kathitattā “imasmiṃ sutte vaṭṭadukkhaṃ kathitan”ti vuttaṃ.
